source_custody.original_episode_results: MG56 no science: ON 1/9 authentic original DEV goals vs matched OFF 3/9
source_custody.prior_frozen_decision_bound: At least 383/422 actual overrides lack prior goal event credit, exact override motive not identifiable because parent action absent from original event ledger.

objective: Make the information needed to interpret genuine source-selected action changes explicit, authenticated and fail closed, without changing a model or creating a first-use permit.

prospective_only.parent_source: parent_action must be measured from actual unmodified original parent chooser BEFORE override, not reconstructed from final chosen action or artificial replay.
prospective_only.source_evidence: All counts and event-mass fields must be measured strictly before current selected outcome, from same owner-validated selected public history, not future labels, unselected outcomes or private state.
prospective_only.goal_mass_definition: Observed engineered public goal event mass must be separately labeled and must never be conflated with genuine positive terminal reward.
prospective_only.comparison: New mechanism must log the same telemetry for selected ON and matched OFF arms; no hidden original state, private map, inventory or oracle.
prospective_only.no_action_rights: Telemetry/validation must NEVER call a chooser, select an action for a live actor, env.reset, env.step, runner, queue, controller, or modify any original protocol.
prospective_only.validation: Validate exact original source public observation bytes/digest only through an owner-authenticated adapter; fail if public observations, parent source identity or selected action intent unavailable.
prospective_only.bind_digest: Canonical sorted-key JSON UTF-8 SHA256 covering full decision witness, linked source event identifier and original-source identities.

precommitted_classification.policy_changed: selected_action differs from parent_action; cannot assert if parent absent.
precommitted_classification.no_selected_feedback: chosen action has zero before-outcome observations.
precommitted_classification.selected_no_goal_effect: chosen action has positive selected before-count and zero prior observed engineered goal-effect mass.
precommitted_classification.selected_with_goal_effect: chosen action has selected observations and positive engineered goal-effect mass; not necessarily original success.
precommitted_classification.explicit_exploration: must be independently declared via bounded purpose/budget rather than inferred from a high novelty or uncertainty score.
precommitted_classification.unsupported: missing parent, invalid digest, stale preaction history, missing source custody, ambiguous action legality or noncanonical witness -> INDETERMINATE, never reassigned to a favored category.

source_only_falsifiers: Reject missing pre-override parent; no inferred label for MG56 original steps.
Reject unknown or future action IDs, non-int bool actions, unsupported source input.
Reject chosen action outside source-validated legal available_actions.
Reject missing or negative pre-selection sample counts or goal masses, goal mass if sample count zero.
Reject negative, NaN, or forged original rewards and malformed terminal flags.
Reject noncanonical JSON or incorrect source-event SHA.
Verify decision intent is before selected outcome, with action/episode/sequence linkage.
Verify an unchanged parent action is not falsely counted as override.
Verify cold canonical witness and digest equality across independent process restarts.
Verify six-action novelty control counterexample carries no positive observed goal evidence even if uncertain score is high.
Verify selected-feedback goal signals distinct from actual positive terminal reward.

scientific_gate.heldout_original_firstuse: BLOCKED: FSA #83 open; this is read-only source-only telemetry engineering only.
scientific_gate.strong_controls: Future authentic independent source-owner experiment must retain unchanged policy OFF, original MG47, MG44, native Wingless/Yggdrasil, independent fitted model-based/Bayesian/recurrent public controls under matched action budgets.
scientific_gate.primary_endpoint: Actual genuine original terminal positive goals, exact mission-target effects and novel-family transfer, NOT novelty/changed pixels/instrumentation count.
scientific_gate.ablation: Separate true goal evidence, public-effect event credit, explicit information-seeking choice and conventional action prediction.
scientific_gate.qualification: Source-only Linux and Windows, frozen-source identity, mandatory full FORGE Linux/Windows after any research branch change; current-main combined-tree integration separately authorized and requalified.
scientific_gate.decision: Syntactically valid telemetry cannot establish model gain; prior NR-M2H and MG56 failure classifications immutable.
